_notes: Bally MPU-6803 (1985-1989): Eight Ball Champ, Beat the Clock, Lady Luck, MotorDome, Black Belt, Heavy Metal Meltdown, City Slicker, Special Force, Strange Science, Party Animal, Dungeons & Dragons, Blackwater 100, Truck Stop, Atlantis, Escape from the Lost World. Motorola 6803 CPU, 2KB battery NVRAM at 0x0000. (Previously these maps were mislabeled gottlieb-system3.)
